facts.material: steel body with internal check-valve assembly set in cement/composite (typical; not stated)
facts.function: fitted to the casing string to guide casing into the wellbore, let the casing float, and prevent backflow of cement
facts.end_use: oil and gas well drilling (casing and cementing operations)

gri_path: GRI 1: first-named article (float collar) classified; float shoe classified the same way

Section XVI note 2(b): parts suitable for use solely or principally with boring or sinking machinery of 8430.41/8430.49 go to heading 8431 (8431.43); Section XV note 2 does not apply since the article is not a part of general use
GRI 6: 8431.43 parts for boring or sinking machinery; 8431.43.80 other; of oil and gas field machinery; suffix .60 other (not tool joints or drill pipe)

rejected_alternatives.reason: CBP in H319171 rejected 7326 for similar casing accessories (stop collars, centralizers) that are dedicated to oil well drilling machinery
the float collar contains a check valve, but the article as a whole is a dedicated downhole casing/drilling component, not merely a valve for pipes
that line is for other (non-oil and gas field) boring or sinking machinery

classification.rationale: Float collars and float shoes are downhole casing components used solely in oil and gas well drilling and cementing, so under Section XVI note 2(b) they are parts of the boring or sinking machinery of 8430.41/8430.49 in 8431.43. HQ H319171 (in force) classified stop collars and centralizers for oil well casing in 8431.43.80 and discussed an earlier HQ decision (H243821, not in the corpus, status unknown and not relied on) on float collars and shoes under heading 8431. The statistical line for other parts of oil and gas field machinery is 8431.43.80.60.
